description: Angular component for configuring a single-switch widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration output.

classes.name: SingleSwitchBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring a single switch widget with form controls, validation, and output configuration.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form inputs.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons to enable based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the enableFullscreen property on widget config based on selected buttons.
